name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 8 visits over 78 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.3 days starting 2025-05-26, at wavelengths from 1.08 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
